flow_name: Asset Serial Split -> Split List -> Split Approval -> new serials
note: Explored LIVE on staging 2026-10-07 with Land BBDASR00227979 (registration 758131). One role: ERP External User (abushoaib.asik) creates and approves. Split no. 67 was created and APPROVED (irreversible). Temporary artifact; the page classes are the permanent locator store.

steps.business_action: Open Asset Profile > Asset Serial Split
steps.locator: link:Asset Serial Split (exact) after clicking text 'Asset Profile'

steps.business_action: Click SPLIT on the serial row, form opens

steps.expected: 2 rows; Percentage/Measurement empty, WDV 0 until percentages typed
empty: 'Split into field is mandatory'; 0/1/-3/100000: 'Please enter a valid integer number between 2 and 100'

steps.business_action: Enter percentage of line 1 (rest auto-fills; last line read-only)
Submit the split (Draft button #save also exists, not clicked)
steps.remarks: Toast not caught on screen; text taken from the POST /faAssetProfile/create response. Client validation texts for Submit read from page script (Percentage value is empty, Total percentage should be equal to 100, etc.).
Not tested: no client-side check; real submit is irreversible.

steps.business_action: Search serial, read the PENDING row (Split No, Group, Project, Dept, Serial, Split Into, Remarks, Created By, Status, Approved By, Approval Date)
steps.expected: 67 | Land | [015] Microfinance (Dabi) | | serial | 2 | AUTOMATION_TEST split note | Abu Shoaib Asik | PENDING | |

steps.business_action: Open Asset Split View popup via split no. link
Created By filter (type 3+ chars, click magnifier icon, pick suggestion), Search, Reset
steps.remarks: Approved By uses the same widget; search not run.

steps.expected_toast: You have to select a split first (both)

steps.locator: tr(has_text=serial) >> input[name=assetSplitApproval]  (header select-all is input[name=post]; do NOT use name=post for rows)

steps.business_action: Click Approve (no confirm dialog, no comment box)
steps.locator: button[onclick="submit();"]  (#btnApprove is duplicated by the popup)
steps.remarks: Toast text from the GET approveAssetSplit response; row turns APPROVED within ~3 s.

steps.expected: APPROVED | Approved By Abu Shoaib Asik | Approval Date 20/09/2026 (business date)

steps.business_action: Search new serials on Global List
steps.expected: BBDASR00227986 (5.01, WDV 10030) and BBDASR00227987 (7.49, WDV 14970): UNASSIGNED, IN_USE. Original BBDASR00227979 no longer listed.
